newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: IADB schedules 1998 general assembly for Colombia.
newsitem.headline: IADB schedules 1998 general assembly for Colombia.

text.p: The general assembly of the Inter-American Development Bank will be held in Colombia next year, Colombia's Finance Ministry said Tuesday.
The annual meeting draws more than 35 finance ministers and top banking representatives from around the world.
The 1998 meeting will be held in the Caribbean port city of Cartagena -- site of the 1995 Summit of the Movement of Non-Aligned Nations. A specific date has not yet been set.
The bank is currently holding this year's meeting, due to finish Wednesday, in Barcelona and has been attended by 4,500 delegates.
The Washington-based Inter-American Development Bank was set up in 1959 and promotes social and infrastructure projects in developing nations through loans and technical assistance.
